Subject: Next steps: stakeholder lanes, procurement timeline & security scope

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) Buying lanes & decision criteria (what we heard)
- Economic buyer: Tom W. (Head of Ops) — primary approval for budget/PO.
- Security reviewers: Sara (Lead InfoSec) + two external auditors (TBD) — will drive systems-in-scope questions.
- Procurement routing: BrightPay central procurement (PO required; standard 45–60 day cycle historically).

Decision criteria you called out: cost per 1M tokens, SLA/uptime guarantees, data residency, and SOC2 + pen-test evidence.

2) Security scope & intake items (we want to avoid surprises)
- Preliminary systems in scope: API endpoints accepting user data, embeddings DB (vectorstore), analytics pipeline (ETL), and the admin console (SaaS control plane).
- Questions for your team: any on-prem components, HVAs, or environments that must be excluded? Also confirm retention window for logs and whether BrightPay requires customer-managed KMS/HSM.

3) Procurement timeline & mutual action plan (MAP)
- Suggested MAP: security questionnaire (this week) -> technical Q/A (next week) -> PO routing + commercial redlines (2–4 weeks) -> signature.
- If procurement needs a stricter timeline, please flag the exact PO cutoffs.

4) Asks (action items)
- Sara: confirm systems that must be included/excluded and whether you need on-prem survey.
- Tom: confirm procurement contact (name + email) and any mandatory PO terms.
- BrightPay: review attached one-page MAP (inline below) and confirm you’re ok with suggested dates.

Attachment stubs: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (we’ll send full spreadsheet), example network diagram (we asked for yours in the next step).

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa to own the questionnaire and Ben on procurement cadence.

Best,
Priyom

Thanks, Priyom — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Systems in scope: confirmed: API endpoints, embeddings DB, admin console. Exclude our payroll-run servers (these are fully on-prem and out of scope).
- Retention: logs for inference calls are retained 30 days by default; we may request 90 days for audit windows — can you confirm if Redwood can retain logs 90 days for a specific account?
- KMS: BrightPay requires customer-managed keys for production data — we’ll need KMS integration options and key rotation notes.
- Procurement contact: Anna Riley <anna.riley@brightpay.com> (cc’ing procurement alias procure@brightpay.com). Typical time-to-PO is 4–8 weeks but if we push we might land closer to 3–4 weeks.

We’ll aim to return your questionnaire by 2026-09-23 EOD. Also, would like to schedule a focused security Q/A on 2026-09-30 (morning PT) — please propose a time.

-Sara

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sara. I’ll own the questionnaire and the 9/30 security Q/A. A few notes and attachments to help speed review: 

1) I’ve attached our redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx — it’s the standard intake we use. If you prefer, we can complete a BrightPay template but using ours speeds the initial pass.
2) Quick answers to Sara’s asks:

  - KMS: we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS and OKTA-managed key integrations; if you use a specific HSM provider please send the vendor details.
  - Network diagram: Sara, could you share your current network-diagram (we requested brightpay-network-diagram.pdf) so our infra team can confirm boundary assumptions?

  - Questionnaire walk-through / open clarifying Qs (15 min)
  - KMS/key management approach & key rotation (10 min)
  - Logging/retention & evidence (5 min)
  - Next steps & timeline (5 min)

4) Action items
  - Sara: confirm 9/30 10:00–10:45 PT or suggest an alternate slot.
  - Anna/procurement: any mandatory contract language for KMS or SLA credits? If so, please send a sample clause.
  - Priyom: please create a HubSpot MAP and link (I’ll reference it during the Q/A).

Attachments (stubs): redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx; brightpay-network-diagram.pdf (placeholder for their diagram).
